entry.title: Watch Tuner Lite
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$1.99 → $0.99 [$0.99 ~ $1.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$0.99

Application Description

Watch Tuner Lite measures the accuracy of mechanical and automatic watches. It uses the built-in microphone or headset microphone to record the audible tick of the watch and calculates the seconds-per-day deviation. Works with almost any 'ticking' watch/clock. Use in a quiet environment. Any ambient noise can affect the accuracy of the results. Complete silence is best. Recommended way to record the ticks is to touch the crown of the watch with the headset microphone. You will get the best results using original Apple EarPods. This is a simple version of Watch Tuner application. Not everyone needs detailed information about a watch movement, sometimes only accuracy is important. Watch Tuner Lite uses very similar algorithm like Watch Tuner does but displays only seconds-per-day deviation. If you want to know how much your watch is fast or slow, this application is for you. If you prefer to measure also beat error and amplitude, try Watch Tuner - a bigger brother of this app. If you need frequency diagram look at Watch Tuner Timegrapher - the most sophisticated app of Watch Tuner series.

Application Description

Guardian OL2 is a retro-style 3D action MMORPG where one hero lives in two worlds. Adventure online with real players, or slip into your private Solo World — your character, gear and diamonds follow you everywhere. TWO WORLDS, ONE HERO • Multiplayer World — a living online realm: team up for dungeons, trade on the auction house, climb the leaderboards • Solo World — a private copy of the continent on your own schedule: no queues, no competition, just you and your followers • One roster — switch freely; progress, items and wallet are shared FIVE CLASSES • Knights Templar — holy knight whose healing and blessings keep the party alive • Magician — fragile but devastating master of fire, frost and arcane power • Witcher — swift blood-clan marksman with precision shots and paralyzing arrows • Greatsword Warrior — titan-born bulwark with taunts, shield walls and crushing blows • Berserker — dwarven fire-worshipper who whirlwinds through enemy ranks A CONTINENT TO CONQUER Follow your class's own storyline across villages, frozen tundras, spider caves and haunted tombs to Gran Village, the hub city where the real hunt begins. Quests, elites and world drops fill every corner. DUNGEONS & BOSSES Fight through the Wolf Lair, Spider Nest, Mystic Tomb, Gruel's Lair and the Dark Lair. Every boss — the Bloodthirsty Wolf King, the Red Dragon, Abalak the Spider, Skeleton King Leon, the Devil Naros — brings a signature trick: summons, freezes, poison, stuns. THREE RISK MODES • Normal — no death penalty; perfect for learning • Nightmare — death costs coins and crystals; better loot and XP • Hell — brutal penalties, the richest drops, and open-world PvP LIFE SKILLS & GEAR Mine ore, gather herbs, fish and hunt — then forge weapons, cook buff food, brew potions and enchant equipment. Enhance, socket gems, and decompose spare gear. Recipe scrolls drop in the wild. Set pieces grant bonus power. TRADE, FOLLOWERS & FACTIONS Sell your loot to real players on the auction house. Hire followers — bats, treants, stone golems, mushroom folk — to fight beside you. Build reputation with five factions (Order of the Holy Light, Titan Legion, Hidden Alliance, Fire of Armas, The Source of Life) and exchange it for exclusive gear. DAILY REWARDS Login gifts, daily deals, daily chests, achievements and server rankings keep every session rewarding. NOW IN 18 LANGUAGES English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Español, Português, Nederlands, Polski, Русский, Türkçe, العربية, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia. The same account works on iOS and Android — progress is never lost. Premium game: pay once, no ads. Optional in-app purchases (diamonds, membership) available.

entry.title: Enchanted Survival: Magic RPG
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$2.99 → $0.99 [$0.99 ~ $2.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$0.99

Application Description

Every enchantment is a gamble. Some of them make you stronger. Others, change the world completely. Enchanted Survival is a survival roguelite. The weapons fire themselves, so the only thing you control is where you stand, and what you enchant and upgrade. Between waves the fighting stops and you walk to a lit shrine, feed it the crystals you picked up off the dead, and ask for an enchantment without being told what is coming. Most enchantments improve an item. Then a pair of boots comes back with Frozenfoot, the lake you have been fighting beside freezes solid under your feet, and the half of the map you could never reach is the half you fight on for the rest of the run. Over 650 enchantments across lots of equipment. Pay for a deeper ritual and the rare results get likelier, and now and then two arrive at once. A clue tells you what the rite is leaning toward. KEEP WHAT YOU ROLLED, OR PUSH IT Strengthen an enchantment through three tiers. Wager crystals at the anvil to temper a piece and raise its own number, then watch the bar run without knowing where it stops. Strip an enchantment out and free the socket. All of it is paid in the same crystals you could have spent on a fresh roll instead. TEN LEVELS THAT EACH FIGHT BACK A meadow built around a lake. A desert of pyramids and one oasis. Glacier basin, volcanic field, mushroom marsh, storm plateau, lighthouse coast, sunken ruins, crystal cavern. Some of them fall dark, and light turns into something you carry, place and stand near. THREE HEROES WHO PLAY DIFFERENTLY The Adventurer, who starts the way the game was written. The Fisher, who swims open water instead of drowning in it and gets chased faster for the privilege. The Ranger, who opens with the bow and turns every ritual up a level. CARRY ONE THING FORWARD Clear a level and one worn item comes with you into every run after it. Finish a run and it pays out shards, which the stall at the head of the road turns into a second weapon, a better starting item, or a first ritual rolled a level deeper than you paid for. FEATURES - Over 650 enchantments, every one of them doing something you can see - Enchant, strengthen, temper and strip, all on one currency - Elites, minibosses and bosses that hold the wave until they fall - Dark levels where light is something you have to bring - A Codex and a bestiary that fill in as you go - One thumb, landscape, built for a phone - Eight languages - Paid once. No ads, no in-app purchases, fully offline

Application Description

432 Player plays the music you already own, retuned live from A = 440 Hz to A = 432 Hz. Nothing is converted or copied in advance: press play and hear your own songs in 432. YOUR MUSIC, RETUNED AS IT PLAYS • 432 Hz, or 528 mode (A = 444 Hz), switched while the song is playing • Two ways to retune: Pitch shift keeps the song's speed; Song speed lowers pitch and tempo together, like a turntable • Hold Compare to hear the original tuning and decide for yourself • A test tone, so you can check the tuning with any tuner A REAL MUSIC PLAYER • Your Music library, the Files app, iCloud Drive and folders you link • MP3, AAC, M4A, FLAC, WAV, AIFF and more • 10-band equalizer with presets and your own settings • Playlists, Up Next, shuffle, repeat and search • Lyrics from the song file or a matching .lrc file, in time with the retuned song • Sleep timer, AirPlay, lock screen and headphone controls • Designed for iPhone and iPad INCLUDED: THE ALBUM DREAMWORLD Twelve tracks by Ophir Paz come with the app, so there is something to play from the first minute. You can hide the album in Settings if you want only your own music. FREE TO USE Every feature is included for free. Free listening gives you 18 minutes of 432 or 528 Hz at a time. Then the tuning rests for one hour, and your music keeps playing at its original pitch. 432 PLAYER PRO Pro removes the limit. One membership also unlocks 432 Player Radio, on iPhone and iPad. ALREADY BOUGHT 432 PLAYER? If you bought 432 Player before version 6, you keep full access for life. There is nothing you need to do. GOOD TO KNOW • Songs from an Apple Music subscription are protected and can't be retuned. Songs you own, bought or imported, play in 432. • Most recorded music is tuned to A = 440 Hz, and that is what the app assumes. • No account and no sign-in. Your music stays on your device. PRIVACY The app collects anonymous usage data and crash reports to help improve it. They are never linked to you and never used for advertising, and you can switch them off in Settings. SUBSCRIPTIONS 432 Player Pro is offered as a monthly or a yearly subscription, and to new listeners as a one-time lifetime purchase for a limited time. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://432player.com/privacy/

Application Description

Film Light，做你口袋里的专业数字测光表！适用于胶片摄影、影视灯光。 基于场景参考(Scene-Referred)的专业摄影测光表 APP。基于 Apple Log 色彩管线，高效测光，精准预览。独创的拟物风拨盘测光 UI，可快速进行光圈优先，快门优先以及手动曝光预览模式切换。内置经典胶片模拟LUT，亦可自定义导入 .cube 文件。支持近 1 度精准点测、智能矩阵测光。便捷的曝光补偿、ND 滤镜计算。 独创的测距功能，依靠LiDAR硬件，实时计算并预览你的景深范围。具备深度俯视图、深度伪色功能。估焦相机再也不用靠猜了！ 不止是测光表，更是你的摄影日志。内置相册功能，支持项目与胶卷管理；相册可查看 EV 点表、随时切换 LUT 预览，让每一次曝光决策都留有记录。 机型要求： iPhone 15 Pro 及后续支持 Apple Log 的机型可获得完整体验。在不支持 Apple Log 的机型上，Film Light 将以 HLG 模式运行；由于该模式下的画面经过局部影调映射（LTM），任意移动取样点后的读数无法保证准确，因此自定义 EV 点表结果并不准确。 测距功能需要使用搭载 LiDAR 硬件的 iPhone，需要 iPhone 12 Pro/Pro Max 以上的 Pro/Pro Max机型。
